newsitem.title: UK: Concorde returns to Heathrow after technical fault.
newsitem.headline: Concorde returns to Heathrow after technical fault.

text.p: A Concorde aircraft returned to London's Heathrow airport on Tuesday after developing a technical fault after takeoff, British Airways said.

A spokeswoman said the flight to New York landed safely at Heathrow after developing a technical problem on the landing gear. The problem was spotted immediately, the plane dumped fuel and it landed 45 minutes later.
"It landed safely about five minutes ago. It was a minor technical fault," the spokeswoman said. She said there were no injuries.

British Airways said the decision for Concorde to return to London was purely precautionary. A small wheel at the back of the plane could not be retracted which meant the plane would not have been able to complete the flight at supersonic speeds.
